name: todo-pane
description: A `📝 todo (n)` button above the prompt, n being the open tasks, and a pane that edits the repository's todo.md in place: toggle, edit, delete and add checkbox tasks while every other line stays byte for byte. /todo opens it.

toggleAction.title: Shortcut action
toggleAction.description: A keybinding action the band button borrows for a shortcut (one of the README's list, e.g. app:cycleDiffBase); your chord for it in ~/.claude/keybindings.json then toggles the pane from the prompt, in the terminal. Empty: no shortcut.
